route.reason: Indications for dupilumab come from its FDA drug label.

draft.text: Dupilumab (DUPIXENT), an interleukin-4 receptor alpha antagonist, is indicated for nine conditions [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:0]. These are: (1) moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis in patients aged 6 months and older whose disease is not adequately controlled with topical prescription therapies or when those therapies are not advisable [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:1]; (2) add-on maintenance treatment of moderate-to-severe asthma with an eosinophilic phenotype or oral corticosteroid-dependent asthma in patients aged 6 years and older [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:1]; (3) add-on maintenance treatment of inadequately controlled chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps in patients aged 12 years and older [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]; (4) eosinophilic esophagitis in patients aged 1 year and older weighing at least 15 kg [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]; (5) prurigo nodularis in adults [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]; (6) add-on maintenance treatment of inadequately controlled COPD with an eosinophilic phenotype in adults [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]; (7) chronic spontaneous urticaria in patients aged 2 years and older who remain symptomatic despite H1 antihistamine treatment [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]; (8) bullous pemphigoid in adults [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:3]; and (9) allergic fungal rhinosinusitis in patients aged 6 years and older with a history of sino-nasal surgery [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:3]. Limitations of use: it is not indicated for relief of acute bronchospasm or status asthmaticus [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2], and not for other forms of urticaria [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:3].
